scene.en: Before class, Kasia, a classmate, asks you about a new student. You think he is from Spain: he speaks Spanish and only a little Polish, and he is nice, cheerful, tall and slim. You like sport. Kasia is a friend, so talk to her as to a friend.

turns.says: Cześć! Czy wiesz, kto to jest?

meaning.en: Hi! Do you know who that is?

replies.text: Nie wiem, ale myślę, że to nowy student.

meaning.en: I don't know, but I think it's a new student.

acceptedAnswers: Nie wiem, ale myślę, że to nowy student.
Nie wiem, ale myślę, że to jest nowy student.

meaning.en: I don't know what it is.

note.en: Kasia asks about a person, so it is *kto*, not *co*: *nie wiem, ale myślę, że to nowy student*.

meaning.en: I wonder where he is from.

replies.text: Chyba z Hiszpanii. Mówi po hiszpańsku.

meaning.en: Probably from Spain. He speaks Spanish.

acceptedAnswers: Chyba z Hiszpanii. Mówi po hiszpańsku.

meaning.en: I am from Spain.

note.en: Kasia wonders where he is from, not you: *chyba z Hiszpanii*.

meaning.en: Does he speak Polish too?
Yes, but only a little.
Yes, I speak Polish.

note.en: *Mówię* is "I speak", but Kasia asks about him. He speaks only a little: *tak, ale tylko trochę*.

meaning.en: What is he like? Nice?

replies.text: Tak, jest bardzo miły i wesoły.

meaning.en: Yes, he is very nice and cheerful.

acceptedAnswers: Tak, jest bardzo miły i wesoły.

replies.text: Tak, jest bardzo miła i wesoła.

meaning.en: Yes, she is very nice and cheerful.

note.en: He is a man, so his adjectives end in *-y*: *miły*, *wesoły*.

meaning.en: And you? Do you like sport?
Yes, I like sport.
Yes, you like sport.

note.en: *Lubisz* is "you like". About yourself say *lubię*: *tak, lubię sport*.

turns.says: Ja też! Myślę, że on też jest wysportowany.

meaning.en: Me too! I think he is sporty too.

replies.text: Na pewno. Jest wysoki i szczupły.

meaning.en: Certainly. He is tall and slim.

acceptedAnswers: Na pewno. Jest wysoki i szczupły.
Masz rację, jest wysoki i szczupły.

replies.text: Na pewno. Jest wysoka i szczupła.

meaning.en: Certainly. She is tall and slim.

note.en: It is still about him, so use the masculine forms: *wysoki* and *szczupły*.

meaning.en: Great! Bye, see you tomorrow!
Bye! See you tomorrow!
Goodbye, madam!

note.en: Kasia is a friend, so *pani* is too formal. To her say *pa* or *do jutra*.

meaning.en: Bye!
